review_method: Read-only source-deck text/structure review and visual inspection of candidate figures; five original PNGs preserved and two embedded EMF AC plots rendered with Pillow Windows GDI at 216 dpi; no simulator/hardware run
role_basis: 1129_진행상황.pptx slide 10 assigns CTLE to the author; author's CTLE development decks and team integration decks provide evidence. Whole RX sampler/DFE/CDR design and final integrated-model results are distinguished from individual CTLE work.
scope_notes: Source filename dates label development snapshots; shared template creation timestamps are not used to establish chronology.
250119 operating-point settings and 250203 XMODEL/merged-RX settings belong to different configurations.
CL 50 fF is a modeling assumption in the 250203 source, not measured input capacitance.
Rctrl_lev/Cctrl_lev are model-control levels; no implemented hardware registers or automatic adaptation inferred.
250203 mid-level ripple and 250205 adjusted input/output pairs are not a controlled quantitative before/after experiment; no noise-spectrum attribution or global-optimum claim.
250205 plots use TX FFE off and scrambled data; exact final control-code vector is not specified on the selected slide.
RX paper 25.6 GBaud/lane is whole-receiver modeling; fabricated TX 32 Gb/s is a separate joint silicon result.
Negative-capacitor/HPF reference studies, copied third-party circuits/specification tables, PDK/server paths and raw IP source are excluded.
